title: Expression and prognosis analyses of CASP1 in acute myeloid leukemia.
authors: Liu, Jing; Zhao, Minyi; Feng, Xiaohui; Zeng, Yunxin; Lin, Dongjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CASP1在急性髓系白血病中的表达与预后，纯基因表达和临床分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Caspase1 (CASP1) is a gene that encodes multiple proteins related to cell death. Nevertheless, the function of CASP1 in the pathogenesis of AML is still unclear. In the present study, a detailed analysis of cancer versus normal samples was performed to explore the relationship between CASP1 and leukemia. We used sequencing data from multiple cancer gene databases to analyze the gene expression and regulatory network of CASP1 in leukemia. We discovered that mRNA expression levels of CASP1 are increased in leukemia cell lines, especially in acute myelocytic leukemia (AML). Then, we verified the mRNA expression of CASP1 in AML clinical samples and observed significantly higher expression of CASP1 in relapsed AML patients. High CASP1 expression was associated with poor prognosis and CASP1 inhibition could impair the proliferation of AML cells. Related functional network identification suggests that CASP1 regulates apoptosis, immune and inflammatory response via pathways involving LYN, LCK, and the E2F family. These findings suggest that CASP1 probably contributes to the pathogenesis, and identify CASP1 as a factor for predicting the prognosis and as a therapeutic target of AML patients.
abstract_zh: Caspase1 (CASP1) 是一个编码多种与细胞死亡相关蛋白的基因。然而，CASP1在急性髓系白血病（AML）发病机制中的功能仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们对癌症与正常样本进行了详细分析，以探讨CASP1与白血病之间的关系。我们利用多个癌症基因数据库的测序数据，分析了CASP1在白血病中的基因表达和调控网络。我们发现，CASP1的mRNA表达水平在白血病细胞系中升高，尤其是在急性髓细胞白血病（AML）中。随后，我们在AML临床样本中验证了CASP1的mRNA表达，并观察到复发AML患者中CASP1的表达显著升高。CASP1高表达与不良预后相关，且抑制CASP1可损害AML细胞的增殖。相关功能网络识别表明，CASP1通过涉及LYN、LCK和E2F家族的途径调节凋亡、免疫和炎症反应。这些发现提示CASP1可能参与AML的发病机制，并将其确定为预测AML患者预后的因子及治疗靶点。
